brainlife.desc: DSI Studio TinyTrack file (tt.gz): compressed streamline coordinates with image dimension and voxel size, in a gzipped MATLAB v4 file.
brainlife.name: neuro/dsistudio/tinytrack

original.desc: The TinyTrack (*.tt.gz) file is a track format used in DSI Studio to store track coordinates. The TT files are MATLAB matrix file stored in V4 version. The tt.gz files are the TT files compressed by gzip. To load a TT file into Matlab, extract the *.tt.gz file into an uncompressed .tt file. Then rename the .tt file to .mat file and load it using Matlab.
original.readme:
> http://dsi-studio.labsolver.org/Manual/export-data-to-matlab

The following is a list of matrix used in TT file:

## dimension

A 1-by-3 vector storing the dimension of the containing image. 

## voxel_size

A 1-by-3 vector storing the voxel size in mm.
 
## track

A int8 array storing the coordinates. The array has the following format

[16-byte track header][3 x n_1 bytes of track data][16-byte track header][3 x n_2 bytes of track data]...

The 16-byte header stores 4 bytes of coordinate count, followed (x,y,z) of the first coodinate multiplied by 32 and converted to 32-bit signed integer.
   
```
   struct {
        uint32_t count;    // number of coordinates
        int32_t x;         // first coordinate (x*32,y*32,z*32)
        int32_t y; 
        int32_t z; 
        } h;
 ```

The track data are series of coodinates intervals (dx1,dy1,dz1)(dx2,dy2,dz2) multiplied by 32 and converted to 8-bit signed integer.

For example, the first track coordinates is (x,y,z)/32, and the second coodinates is calculated by { (x,y,z) + (dx1,dy1,dz1) }/32

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

identifying_risks: Individual white matter geometry can support re-linkage as a structural fingerprint
Headers and metadata may carry subject codes or acquisition dates
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 4: participant-level processed neurodata without direct identifiers. Tier 4 conditions apply if used as a connectome fingerprint.
sharing_cautions: Share with coded subject IDs under a data use agreement
Strip free-text tags and dates from metadata before release
tier_conditions: Tier 1 only once aggregated across participants (e.g. a population atlas)
Tier 4 if used to build connectome fingerprints or predictive features

intended_use: DSI Studio tract shape analysis and conversion to .trk.
not_suitable_for: MRtrix or DIPY Apps; convert to .trk or .tck first.
